title: Pathway to Glory: Ikusa Islands
notes: Start game > Soloplayer > New creates a campaign (name, insignia, difficulty); the first mission is 1942 First Blood.

The game is turn-based: move the cursor over the map and press OK to send the selected soldier there (the green line shows the path and what it costs). Key 7 opens the mission menu with End turn, Mission data / Audio, Use (weapons and gear), Commands and End mission.
Cooperative and multiplayer games need Bluetooth or N-Gage Arena and are not available in the browser.
The card is the largest in the catalogue (54 MB), so the first start takes longer than other games.

controls.source: The shortcuts shown in the game's own Commands menu (shoot 6, stance up 8, stance down 0, look at 9, previous 1, next 3) and the soft key labels in its menus; the cursor, OK, key 7 and the 1, 3, 9 and 0 shortcuts were observed in the first mission. The year is from general knowledge of the game.

actions.up: Move the cursor / scroll the map
actions.down: Move the cursor / scroll the map
actions.left: Move the cursor / scroll the map
actions.right: Move the cursor / scroll the map
actions.ok: Select (menus); send the selected soldier to the cursor
actions.7: Mission menu (end turn, use gear, commands)

notes: The standard layout suits this game: arrows move the cursor, Enter is OK, Q and W are the soft keys, and the digit row gives 1, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 0.
On a gamepad A is OK, Y opens the mission menu (its Commands list has every action, so the number shortcuts are not needed), LB selects and RB goes back.

statusNote: Logos, title, menus, campaign creation, briefing, team and gear selection work, and the first mission (1942 First Blood) plays on the battle map: moving a soldier, switching soldiers, stance, look-at and the mission menu were tried.
